name: Hotel Eggerwirt
beschreibung: Hotel Eggerwirt is situated right in the centre of Söll within the renowned Wilder Kaiser holiday region. Its central location grants immediate access to the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski domain as well as numerous scenic hiking paths in summer. This family-run hotel features comfortable rooms in traditional Tyrolean design, a revitalising wellness area with sauna, and a restaurant serving authentic local cuisine as part of the half-board arrangement.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Eggerwirt in central Söll offers authentic Tyrolean hospitality, half-board regional dining, a sauna wellness area, and direct access to SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser.
